name: Studious Dilettante
body:
Whether you are an Investigator or not, you are versed in one particular course of study.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Skill Focus with the focus skill of the course of study selected for this feat (see below), character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Select one course of study listed for a legendary investigator. You must have Skill Focus in the focus skill related to the selected course of study (for example, Perform for the Arts course of study). This course of study cannot be one you already have. You gain one first-level ability granted by the selected course of study. For purposes of using that ability, treat your legendary investigator level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in legendary investigator. You do not gain any of the other abilities from the selected course of study.
